name: app-black-discover-feed-phone-behind-cropped-ghost-letters
title: Discover Feed Phone over Grey Ghost Letters
whatItIs: A cover on black with giant grey letters cropped by the phone, a hand holding a white 'Welcome to Your Discover Feed' screen with a search bar and a destination photo card.
whatItMeans: High contrast between the white UI and black background makes the screen pop, and the cropped letters add depth.
techniques: Ghost lettering partially hidden by the device
Hand cropped in from the left
Bold two-line title in the UI

vocabulary.definition: Large text partially hidden behind another object.
A browsing screen of recommended items.
A cover where the subject is brightest against a dark ground.
